description: Tangtang alone (P5, Brigand's Calling, MI Security hand + 3 Bonekrusha: the build in fixtures/zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8.json with weapon skill 3 at level 9) vs Rhodagn, ultimate charged. Battle skill with no Whirlpool: one Waterspout, whose first tick inflicts Cryo (Brigand's Calling: Cryo DMG +56%) and opens her combo; the combo leaves a Whirlpool (talent 1: team Haste 20%, which speeds up her frames in the engine); the next battle skill consumes it (25 SP back) for two Waterspouts and 10% Arts Susceptibility (Brigand's Calling: Arts DMG Taken +16.8%). Ultimate: OLDEN STARE (8 DoT ticks, Immobilization that freezes the enemy's clock 4 s, so the pending Cryo burst lands late) and the rogue wave; no dive attack (rotations can't cast one yet), so the early wave and Riot Bringer don't happen. Then a basic chain and two more battle skill / combo pairs as SP allows.
